overall: Ashland Development Liaison Group violated the OML by failing to post notice for April 10 and May 14 meetings, posting notices in varying locations, and inadequate August 28 minutes; no intentional violation found.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Town failed to provide requested meeting minutes and notices for the Group.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the request for meeting minutes did not fall under the Open Meeting Law

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Group's August 28 meeting minutes were insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law requires that meeting minutes include more than a statement that a public body held a discussion about a specified topic; the Law requires that the minutes summarize the discussion that was held.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Group failed to post any notice for its April 10 and May 14 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We agree and find that the Group violated the Open Meeting Law because it failed to post notice for its meetings held on April 10 and May 14.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Group posted notices in a confusing manner, some under its own name and some under the Board of Selectmen.
allegations.key_passage: we find that members of the public could not easily locate and access its meeting notices, violating the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the August 28 meeting discussed his Open Meeting Law complaint, a topic not on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: We conclude that the discussion of the Group’s Open Meeting Law violation naturally flowed from the noticed meeting topic.

allegations.summary: Complainant urged that the Group's violations were intentional; the AG considered whether to find intent.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore decline to find an intentional violation.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged Group members did not file Open Meeting Law certifications on time.
allegations.key_passage: This allegation was addressed in a previous determination, issued by our office on March 13, 2020.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged Group members were not properly appointed.
allegations.key_passage: this allegation falls outside of the Open Meeting Law and we decline to review it.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days of receipt of the letter, revise the August 28 meeting minutes to include a sufficient level of detail and certify to the AG's office that this was done.
remedy_passage: we order the Group, within 30 days of receipt of this letter, to revise its minutes for its August 28 meeting to include a sufficient level of detail, and to certify to our office that it has done so.
